_notes: This empty template intentionally fails coverage until real reviewed files are declared in assets. No screenshot or readback proof is prepopulated.
Five screenshots and one preview per declared combination are Scriba quality targets; Apple's minimum is one screenshot and zero optional previews. Maximums are ten screenshots and three previews.
Device IDs below are local audit slots, never App Store Connect API enum values. Verify all live slots, accepted dimensions and API values before each release.
Dated reference: 2026-11-07. Landscape capture dimensions must be added explicitly by reversing the verified portrait dimensions when that orientation is in scope.

Duo inner display (2007x2853 portrait, 2853x2007 landscape) is not declared in this historical three-slot baseline. Discover the live slot and extend devices/scope as required; do not assume it is absent or covered by outer-display media.
Apple documents Duo screenshots as required starting April 2027 for apps built with iOS 27.1 SDK or later. Recheck that deadline and SDK condition live.
The example Custom Product Page includes the primary locale plus its target English locale. Add only the pages and locales actually requested; default listing localizations do not create CPPs.

Each asset declares page, locale, device, kind, position, file, ui_locale, content_locale and visual_reviewed. ui_locale/content_locale must match the target locale. Only explicitly reviewed language_neutral=true media may use und and reuse identical bytes across locales.

Use screenshot, app_preview or marketing_gif as kind. GIF is a separate marketing deliverable and never satisfies preview coverage. Screenshots audited by this helper must be opaque PNG; App Previews require ffprobe-verified MOV/M4V/MP4.

Readback for screenshots and App Previews requires supplied store evidence: asset_id, state COMPLETE, assigned true, exact page/locale/device, confirmed_after_reload true, inherited false and fallback false. Marketing GIFs are exempt from App Store readback but retain local file/hash/language checks and never satisfy App Preview coverage. Those assertions require actual manual/API readback; the helper performs no Apple or OCR operations.
